info.title: Clumsy Keys API
info.description: Complete first-party HTTP API plus a documented x-socketio event contract. HTTP paths are registered by http.ts, account.http.ts and leaderboard.http.ts; Socket.IO transport is not a collection of REST endpoints. Supabase Auth/Data API and the local test fixture are external dependencies, not application endpoints. Account identity comes only from verified bearer tokens. API JSON bodies are limited to 1 MiB. All app HTTP responses are no-store. /api and /rooms share 240 requests/minute per transport IP; authenticated writes additionally share 30/minute per verified account; 429 has Retry-After. /health is exempt. Unknown application routes return 404. See SECURITY_AUDIT.md for trust limits and DEPLOYMENT.md for HTTPS origins and service setup.

servers.description: Local backend; replace with the Northflank public HTTPS origin for hosting.

tags.name: Multiplayer
tags.description: Public live-room roster; live events are in x-socketio.

get.description: Liveness/readiness endpoint, exempt from API/room quotas. Does not test Supabase or its migrations.
Returns live display names, browser racer IDs, typed characters, WPM and accuracy; no bearer token is needed. Unknown rooms return 404.

parameters.name: roomId
parameters.description: Exactly one nonblank room ID. Repeated query values are rejected.

get.description: Read your display name, nullable unique handle and preferences. Existing accounts without a claimed handle return null.

All saved solo tests; arithmetic per-test means; highest WPM per mode; five latest tests. Excludes guests, unsaved/abandoned tests and multiplayer. Characters = correct + incorrect + extra; mean duration is derived by the UI from seconds/tests.

put.summary: Save preferences with an optimistic revision
put.description: Save preferences with an optimistic revision

post.summary: Save a completed solo test idempotently
post.description: Same-owner UUID retries return success without duplicate rows. The verified token supplies ownership; posted owner fields are ignored. Four-character WPM = floor(correct*15/elapsedSeconds). Plausible client counters are not proof of honest typing.

201.description: Result saved, or same-owner retry already saved.

get.summary: Read your paginated practice or race history
get.description: Twenty rows maximum, newest first with stable ID tie-breaks. nextOffset is null when fewer than 20 rows are returned; an exactly full last page can lead to an empty next page.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: Required history type; determines the response row schema.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Optional zero-based offset, supplied as 1-6 decimal digits.

get.summary: Read your saved solo result and details
get.description: Read your saved solo result and details

get.summary: Read a saved race scoreboard as a participant
get.description: Participation is resolved from the verified account. room IDs and browser racer IDs do not authorize reads. Opponent account UUIDs and participant IDs are excluded from shared results.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Round UUID or latest for your most recently saved round.

get.summary: Read public solo rankings and optional personal standing
get.description: All six filters are required. Filters apply before selecting one best result per player, ordered by WPM, accuracy, earlier date, then result ID. Ten rows/page; currentUser may be outside the page. No token is needed for public rows; a supplied invalid token returns 401. Account UUIDs, emails and detailed keystrokes are excluded. Quote/snippet length selectors do not currently partition these boards.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Prose display key, e.g. english 2k; Dev key, e.g. randomPy. Quotes use english.

parameters.name: length
parameters.description: 0 for quotes/snippets; 15/30/60/120 for timed formats; 25/50/100/200 for word formats.

parameters.name: range
parameters.description: All time, rolling 30 days, 7 days or 1 day.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Required requested page; response clamps it to available pages.

put.summary: Choose or change your unique public handle
put.description: Authenticated owner only. Trim and lowercase the submitted handle; accept 3–24 ASCII letters, digits or underscores. The database atomically enforces case-insensitive uniqueness. A conflicting claim returns 409 with Handle already taken; the previous handle is retained. Retrying the same owner/handle is safe. Display names and room aliases are unaffected. Shares the account write quota; transient verification/database failures return 503.

409.description: Handle already claimed by another account. Choose another handle; the prior value is retained.

example.error: Handle already taken. Choose another handle.

get.summary: Read your WPM best for a practice category
get.description: Authenticated, owner-scoped read of the highest saved WPM across all matching results, independent of history pagination. Category = practice mode, language, active test type and length. Prose accepts time/words with a positive integer length up to 86400, or quotes with short/medium/long. Code keywords accepts time/words with a numeric length; code snippets accepts snippets with short/medium/long. Prose uses English/Hinglish catalog IDs; code uses randomPy/randomJs/randomTs/randomJava/randomCpp/randomC. Modifiers, difficulty and auto-indent do not subdivide these categories. Quotes without archived quoteLength count as medium. Snippets without archived snippetLength cannot be attributed and are excluded. Returns null when no matching saved result exists. No writes; no-store. The client snapshots before saving the new result; read failures suppress celebration while keeping its account-bound retry entry.

200.description: Highest matching saved WPM, or null for an unestablished category.

supabaseBearer.description: User access token verified through Supabase Auth; never use a publishable API key or server secret as the bearer identity.

BadRequest.description: Invalid query, identifier, preferences, result, or malformed JSON.

Unauthorized.description: Missing, malformed, invalid or expired bearer token.

example.error: Sign in to access your account.

NotFound.description: Room or owner-visible result not found; ownership is not disclosed.

Conflict.description: Stale preference revision or result UUID owned by another account.

PayloadTooLarge.description: JSON body exceeds the 1 MiB API limit.

Unavailable.description: Persistence is unconfigured or Auth/database service is unavailable. Retry transient failures.

RateLimited.description: Request or verified-account write quota exceeded.

example.error: Too many requests. Please retry shortly.

accounts.description: Configuration present; does not establish database reachability or migration health.

ProseSettings.description: Exactly one of timer, words, quotes is non-null. quoteLength is optional for legacy settings and defaults to medium when selecting a quote. Length filters preserve full quote text; short <=100, medium 101-300, long >300 characters.

snippetLength.description: Optional archived length for snippet results. New snippet completions include it; older results may omit it and cannot be assigned to a length-specific PB.

CodePracticeSettings.description: Saved code results require autoTabs in addition to code preferences. Snippet results may include snippetLength; its category lookup uses only known archived lengths. This does not change account preferences or public leaderboard grouping.

Preferences.description: Unknown fields are discarded by the backend allowlist. A snippet-length preference is not currently persisted.

Sample.description: Sample seconds must increase strictly and must not exceed elapsedSeconds.

PracticeSubmission.description: language must match settings.language. Code modes must match settings.mode. Attempts must be positive and attempts*15/elapsedSeconds <=1500. The backend recomputes WPM/raw/accuracy/deviation and ignores submitted summary metrics and unknown fields. Result UUID retries are idempotent for the same owner; cross-owner reuse conflicts.

RaceHistoryEntry.description: Private owner-only history row. Shared race scoreboards use RaceScoreboardEntry and omit account_id and participant_id.

userId.description: Pseudonymous player key, not an account UUID.

RoomJoin.description: Identity strings must contain non-whitespace and exclude ASCII control characters. Reconnect uses the server-issued resumeToken for the same account/guest identity within 30 seconds.

startsAt.description: Countdown deadline in Unix milliseconds, when present.

TimeData.description: Only the current socket owner may update an unfinished playing racer. typedChars cannot exceed the passage length; updates failing checks are ignored.

RaceSettingsPatch.description: A valid changed subset is accepted only from a joined racer while waiting. Changes clear all votes and cancel the countdown. Empty, unchanged, invalid or unknown-field patches are ignored.

Handle.description: Unique public handle stored in lowercase, without the @ prefix.

x-socketio.description: Socket.IO v4 framing/handshake, not a raw WebSocket JSON API. OpenAPI tooling ignores this extension; the event payloads use the same component schemas. The bundled Socket.IO client/Engine.IO handshake and transport endpoints are protocol implementation details, not separate app REST operations.

handshake.description: Absent/null/empty accessToken permits guest play. A supplied token must verify; failure raises connect_error and the authenticated socket disconnects on token expiration. Browser Origin must be allowed by FRONTEND_ORIGINS; clients with no Origin are allowed but still subject to identity/resume checks.

joinRoom.description: Create/join a waiting room or resume the same racer/account. Playing and finished rooms reject new racers; existing racers can resume with their recovery token. Success emits roomSession and roomData; rejected joins emit error.

startVote.description: Joined owner votes while waiting. All racers ready, with at least two racers, schedules a five-second countdown.

stopVote.description: Joined owner removes their vote and cancels the countdown while waiting.

updateRaceSettings.description: Joined waiting racer applies a validated changed settings patch; votes reset.

timeData.description: Report live progress for the owned playing racer; not cheat-resistant.

finishGame.description: Complete an owned racer only after reported typedChars equals text length. Ignored for time mode, whose completion is server-owned.

resetGame.description: Joined racer resets a finished room, preserving settings and redrawing content on the next start.

roomData.description: Room settings/roster/progress snapshot. Final snapshots add speedHistory and finishSeconds when available.

roomSession.description: Opaque server-issued recovery token; keep it private and return it on reconnect.

error.description: Application-level join or ownership failure; distinct from connect_error.

persistenceStatus.description: Best-effort race archive save status when backend persistence is configured. At most 100 pending rounds and five attempts per round; process loss discards the queue.

transportEvents.connect_error: Socket.IO connection/authentication failure, represented by an Error object, not the application {msg} payload.
transportEvents.disconnect: Socket.IO lifecycle event, no application payload contract. Disconnected racers have a 30-second resume window; explicit leave is implemented by disconnecting.

x-socketio.guarantees: Server owns countdown deadlines and finish timestamps. Invalid/unauthorized vote, progress, patch, finish and reset messages are generally ignored without acknowledgements. Active rooms/timers/resume sessions are in memory and are lost on restart. Persisted result reads use the HTTP history routes.
